key_provisions_or_claims: Russia needs a comprehensive legal framework for robotics and AI.
Terminology of 'robot', 'AI' and 'robotics' needs clear legal definitions.
Compares European, American, Japanese and Chinese regulatory approaches.
Proposes a federal law or CyberCode covering robotics relations.
Recommends adopting the federal law 'On the Fundamentals of Legal Regulation of Relations in the Sphere of Robotics'.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article analysing legal regulation of robotics and AI in Russia amid Industry 4.0. It examines definitions of robot and robotics, compares EU, US, Japanese and Chinese approaches, and recommends adopting a framework federal law on the fundamentals of legal regulation of robotics, possibly a CyberCode.
annotation.title_clean: Legal regulation of relations related to the use of robotics in the context of digital transformation in the Russian Federation
